[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Hu Marell]] was considered to be [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] top battlefield surgeon during the war with the Sith Empire. While saving wounded soldiers in a secret hospital on [[Quesh]], he attracted the attention of an [[HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] and considered for elimination among two other targets.

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Marell was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during conversations between Imperial players and their HK-51 units. He is also listed in the game's NPC file with HK-51's other targets, but whatever missions that would have involved Marell and the others never made it into the game.
